workshops.title: Contoso Health: ward insights from feedback and forms
workshops.summary: Build a healthcare insight pipeline that analyzes patient feedback and extracts intake data for ward-level operational visibility.
workshops.description: In this workshop, you'll build an end-to-end healthcare insight workflow for Contoso Health using Azure AI services. You'll start by analyzing patient feedback text to identify sentiment and key themes by ward, then extend the solution by extracting structured data from scanned patient intake forms and other multimodal documents. Along the way, you'll apply a realistic hospital scenario with privacy, auditability, and operational reporting needs in mind.
workshops.scenario: Contoso Health, a hospital group, wants to turn patient feedback and paper intake forms into ward-level insight for its clinical operations team.

workshops.title: Build Zava's omnichannel AI shopping assistant
workshops.summary: Plan, build, and extend a vision-enabled retail assistant for Zava using Azure AI and agents.
workshops.description: In this workshop, you'll plan and build key foundations of an AI-powered retail assistant for Zava, a DIY home improvement chain. You'll start by defining the AI project, success criteria, and responsible AI considerations, then create a vision-enabled chat experience that can understand product and part images from customers, and finally extend the solution with AI agents in Azure AI Foundry and VS Code that can reason over retail tasks and take actions such as helping customers find products, answering shopping questions, and supporting assisted commerce scenarios.
workshops.scenario: Zava, a retail DIY chain, is building an omnichannel AI shopping assistant that helps customers find the right products in store and online, understands photos of parts customers bring in, and can act on their behalf.
